title: Markooj add-in manifest
description: manifest.json, attached to every add-in release next to main.js (and styles.css when the add-in has one).

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

id.description: 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, such as word-count. It never changes between versions.

name.description: The name shown on the add-in's card, on one line.

version.description: The add-in's version in semver form, such as 1.0.0. Raise it for every release.

minMarkooj.description: The oldest Markooj version the add-in works with, in semver form, such as 1.1.0.

author.description: Your name or your team's name, on one line.

authorUrl.description: Optional web address that starts with https://.

description.description: One sentence about what the add-in does, on one line, at most 250 characters.

icon.description: Optional Markooj icon name for the card, such as table or sparkle. Default: puzzle.

category.description: Optional. One of: writing, research, math, languages, export, productivity, developer, fun, other.

license.description: Optional SPDX license name of the add-in, such as MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later.

permissions.description: Optional plain note shown before install when the add-in does more than edit the open document, such as "Downloads word lists from example.org".

files.description: Optional extra data files attached to the same release. Up to 50 MB for the whole add-in.

name.description: A plain file name with letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, such as words.json. Not manifest.json, main.js or styles.css.
